rules._comment: Block h1(10.0.0.1) <-> h3(10.0.0.3) ICMP. They are on s1 and s2, with multiple redundant paths (s1-s2 direct, s1-s4-s5-s2, s1-s5-s2). Firewall rules are installed on ALL switches, so even with redundant paths, these hosts become unreachable.
Reverse direction: h3 -> h1 ICMP also blocked.
Block h5(10.0.0.5) <-> h8(10.0.0.8) ICMP. They are on s4 and s6, with multiple paths (s4-s5-s6, s4-s1-s2-s3-s6, s4-s1-s5-s6, etc.). Again, firewall rules override any path redundancy.
Reverse direction: h8 -> h5 ICMP also blocked.
